stories.headline: Homebuilder sentiment plunges to 14-year low, leading more builders to drop prices
stories.summary: US homebuilder confidence has collapsed to its lowest level in 14 years, forcing developers to reduce asking prices to attract buyers. This signals weakening demand in residential real estate amid elevated mortgage rates.
stories.why_matters: Housing weakness suggests consumer confidence erosion and potential drag on GDP growth ahead.

stories.headline: Investors look to Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's IPO to refresh the tech rally
stories.summary: Markets are pivoting to major tech catalysts including Nvidia earnings results and Anthropic's highly anticipated IPO debut. These events are expected to reignite momentum in the artificial intelligence and semiconductor sectors.
stories.why_matters: Tech earnings and IPO reception will test equity valuations and signal investor appetite for growth after recent S&P 500 weakness.

stories.headline: FOMC Press Release
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve's policy announcement and guidance on interest rates is scheduled for release on November 20. This follows recent yield curve steepening with 10Y yields rising 5 bps.
stories.why_matters: FOMC communications will determine near-term rate expectations and bond market direction given current 5.15% 10Y yield and elevated VIX at 22.91.

calendar.note: Federal Reserve policy decision will anchor rate expectations; critical given 10Y already up 5 bps this week.
EPU index reflects market stress; elevated VIX at 22.91 suggests data will be closely watched.
Interest rate survey will provide context on Fed policy transmission amid ongoing yield volatility.
Fed funds rate data confirms current policy stance affecting mortgage rates and homebuilder sentiment.

concept.title: Yield Curve Steepening & Housing Demand Collapse
concept.one_liner: Rising long-end rates (10Y +5 bps) are compressing affordability just as homebuilder sentiment hits a 14-year low, creating a vicious cycle of reduced demand and price capitulation.
concept.explanation: The 10Y Treasury moved 5 bps higher to 5.15% while 2Y rose only 2 bps, steepening the curve but locking in higher mortgage rates for marginal buyers. Simultaneously, homebuilder sentiment plunged to its worst level in 14 years, forcing price cuts. This dynamic reveals rate sensitivity in housing and consumer resilience stress—a leading indicator of potential GDP weakness ahead of Friday's FOMC decision.
concept.market_link: S&P 500 down 0.43% and VIX up 3.61 points reflect this macro headwind; Nvidia earnings and Anthropic IPO (Friday/this week) will test whether growth-at-any-cost thesis survives housing deterioration.

narrative: Equities declined 0.43% while volatility spiked 3.61 VIX points as homebuilder sentiment hit a 14-year low amid rising rates (10Y +5 bps to 5.15%), signaling housing demand stress that could weigh on consumer confidence and GDP growth. Markets await Friday's FOMC release and major tech catalysts (Nvidia, Anthropic IPO) to determine whether the rally can be sustained or if rate-driven headwinds will dominate.
